resources.string: SMS permission lets the app save bank purchase messages as uncategorized expenses.
Take control of your spending with %1$s — a simple way to track expenses and stay organized. Try it today!\n%2$s
Live weekly spending pace, encouragement and a small reduction goal. Tap for details.
Usual: %1$s per day across the preceding %2$s weeks
Small challenge: aim for %1$s or less over 7 days — 5%% below your usual spending. Try delaying one optional purchase.

Keep recording expenses consistently. The meter needs at least 5 weeks of history, including spending before the latest week, to compare fairly. The number is your recorded spending over the last 7 days divided by 7.

The number is your daily average over the last 7 days, including recent purchases. Your usual pace uses 4–8 complete weeks before that. Green means at least 5% lower; amber means less than 15% higher; coral means 15% higher or more.\n\nThis compares recorded spending, not affordability. Bills and large purchases count too; higher spending may be necessary. Missing entries can make the meter look better. Investments and excluded category splits are left out. The challenge updates with your usual pace; it is not a fixed budget.
